description: List the full HelloBooks marketing feature catalog (145+ items). Filter by category, tier, status, marketedOnly, or substring query.

category.description: Filter to one feature category (core-accounting, invoicing-billing, etc.).

limit.description: Max number of features to return. Default 200.

marketedOnly.description: If true, only return features marketed on the public website.

query.description: Optional substring match against label + shortDescription.

status.description: Filter by rollout status. Defaults to all.

tier.description: Filter by the minimum plan tier / add-on that unlocks the feature.

name: list_features
